input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on us. Section 12.3 affirmatively preserves our freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service, to engage any supplier and to operate in any field or territory, and records that we have given no exclusivity or non-compete commitment; Section 2.1 confirms no minimum or purchase commitment. This meets the preferred position (no restriction at all). The only restrictions binding us are the ordinary acceptable-use limits in Section 13.4 (no reverse engineering, no interference, no unlawful use), which are not competitive or field-of-use restraints. Section 2.2's "sole and exclusive provider" language is a sole-source/exclusivity term that is inconsistent with Section 12.3; it is addressed under the exclusivity rule and is not double-flagged here.
